title: Enable browser-native Leaf installation
purpose: Let supported browsers detect the Leaf web app manifest on its GitHub Pages subpath and offer their native installation invitation without adding a custom prompt or service worker.
changes: Changed the manifest and favicon links to deployment-relative paths so they resolve under the Leaf project URL.
Added explicit manifest id, start URL, and scope values that remain inside the Leaf deployment path.
Kept installation timing under browser control with no custom prompt or offline cache behavior.

tests.name: npm.cmd run build
tests.details: Vite build completed; the existing large-chunk warning remains.

tests.details: Verified relative manifest and icon links plus id, start_url, scope, display, and icon values in dist.

next_actions: Verify the deployed manifest and icon URLs and allow the supported browser to control invitation timing.
